integrity: The proof uses the published six support classes, an explicit complete forcing-profile census, an exact rank-four quotient witness, and algebraic inversion of the polynomial coefficients to recover all three field orders.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three field factors are assumed.
All field orders are at least three; binary factors require a separate singleton-type analysis.
The real symmetric minimum-rank convention is used.
The triangular-prism support decomposition and generic twin-type compression are prior work.
title: Zero forcing polynomials reconstruct three-field annihilator graphs
